set_aside.question: Which enumerations do the cells of EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS and NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS name, what are their members, and which module owns those enumerations? No such node-conclusion or conclusion-effect enumeration is defined in models or elsewhere.
options: Define the missing closed enumerations in models and specify both tables against them
Use identified existing models enumerations as the cell types
Make the tables return non-enumerated values owned and defined by their consuming modules

set_aside.text: the conclusion each NodeExecution status gives (A13 rules 5 and 7)
set_aside.question: How can a total table keyed only by NodeExecution status determine the conclusion of outcome_unknown when A11 rule 3 says that conclusion also depends on the EffectAttempt status and whether the binding has output ports, and run_graph says operation conclusions come from effects.operation_element_conclusion?
options: Exclude outcome_unknown from this table and let effects determine it, making the table non-total over NodeExecution statuses
Map outcome_unknown to a distinct contextual/delegated member that tells run_graph to use effects.operation_element_conclusion
Key the mapping by additional effect-attempt and binding-output facts rather than only NodeExecution status
set_aside.default_guess: Map outcome_unknown to an explicit contextual/delegated conclusion member, with effects retaining ownership of resolving it from the attempt and binding.
